note: The act amends legal text (electronic records in books) and states no customs system, single window or data exchange.

facts.fact: The Uganda Revenue Authority says ASYCUDA World is an online system used for processing all goods imported or exported, in which agents capture, validate and assess declarations and importers self-declare and pay taxes.

note: Only names Uganda as a Northern Corridor country; RECTS is cargo tracking, not clearance.

facts.fact: The Uganda Revenue Authority's Q&A column says importers lodge declarations in its customs system, where controlled HS codes need prior authorisation, while air-cargo manifest data entry is still manual.
The URA says it is in advanced stages of automating and integrating systems with airlines at Entebbe for electronic submission of cargo manifests before arrival.

The Uganda Revenue Authority says an automation process links EFRIS export invoices with ASYCUDA, and it trained clearing agents on 19 May 2025 ahead of export fiscalisation for exports outside the EAC.

A KRA officer writing in WCO News says Uganda Revenue Authority scans all cargo entering or leaving Uganda and matches it to customs declarations, sharing them through the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform since July 2024.

A KRA officer writing in WCO News says the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform, built for six partner states, has shared customs declarations and scanned-cargo images since July 2024, with Uganda sending over 8,000 images to Kenya.

Uganda's WTO notification G/TFA/N/UGA/4 of 12 June 2024 reports 22 of a target 45 agencies actively operational on the e-Single Window, with interfaces to commercial banks and online permits and certificates.
The Uganda Revenue Authority's UESW page says the single window is built on the ASYCUDA World platform and lists an upgrade of the customs ASYCUDA World system.
The Uganda Revenue Authority's UESW page says the Uganda Electronic Single Window has automated 22 of 30 border agencies, which can issue permits and certificates electronically.

note: RECTS is a cargo tracking system; no declaration processing or customs data exchange system is stated.

facts.fact: TradeMark Africa reports that the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform, with scanner image sharing first implemented between Kenya and Uganda in 2024.
facts.system: EAC Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform

facts.fact: A 2024 journal article surveys 118 Uganda Revenue Authority staff in three eastern branches on the implementation success of the ASYCUDA World customs data system in use at the authority.

The URA newsletter says the Uganda Electronic Single Window (UeSW) lets international traders and government submit regulatory documents at a single location; it gives no launch date, so as_of is the newsletter's published date.

The URA newsletter says Uganda customs first introduced ASYCUDA in the late 1990s and has upgraded it to the current ASYCUDA World; it gives no date for the current state, so as_of is the newsletter's published date.

note: An E-Single Window is listed under the Ministry of Internal Affairs with no customs clearance or border agencies stated.
